points.description: First correct parameter from the model answer list, named with the correct technical term: frequency of vibration, amplitude of vibration, abrasive slurry concentration, or slurry (abrasive) particle diameter/size.
Second distinct correct parameter from the same list, named precisely with the correct technical term.
Third distinct correct parameter from the same list, named precisely with the correct technical term.

rubric.notes: Three distinct parameters are required, each from: frequency of vibration, amplitude of vibration, abrasive slurry concentration, slurry particle diameter (size). Each correct, precisely named item earns its own share. Vague items (e.g. just "speed", "force", "material") earn nothing, and a wrong extra item costs a point, so a wrong item among the three earns nothing for that slot and a wrong extra item beyond three removes one point. Duplicates count once.
